old_problem: PMIC vendor/revision raw-register semantics, exact EWL/capacity oracle, controlled AC cycle and signed IFWI/CMOS recovery are platform-specific and destructive.
disposition_reason: ED-16 and ED-18 require approved fault injection, complete power-cycle evidence and Recovery. Raw0x82 behavior is not uniform across PMICs; the test intentionally shuts down, disables DIMMs and may require IFWI reflash or CMOS clear. Those semantics and recovery authorization cannot be inferred from generic standards.
decision_basis: Preserved raw register injection, shutdown, AC cycle, exact EWL codes, two64GB reduction, boot, PMIC history and full recovery.

test_case.test_name: GNR DDR5 PMIC critical-temperature isolation and recovery
test_case.purpose: Prove an approved PMIC critical-temperature fault shuts down, causes exact BIOS channel isolation/history, boots degraded, and can be fully recovered.
required_package: Approved PMIC PN/vendor/revision and Intel CScripts semantics
Signed IFWI or CMOS recovery, OOB and rollback plan
test_case.test_command: Qualified operator proves clean PMIC/status/capacity baseline, performs one approved raw0x82 reg0x35 injection, captures shutdown, performs one authorized AC cycle, verifies exact serial EWLs, disabled ranks and reduced memory, reads regs0x4=0x10 and0x5 critical-temp history, preserves evidence, then separately clears status and performs the approved IFWI/CMOS recovery to restore full memory and settings.
test_case.expected_result: The target PMIC causes one attributable shutdown; BIOS isolates only the expected channel/ranks, logs exact warnings, boots with expected reduced capacity, preserves the history bits, and approved recovery restores full healthy memory.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires PMIC identity/semantics, clean baseline, one shutdown and full AC-to-OS-ready trace, exact EWL/capacity/history, and complete authorized recovery. Wrong target, hang, unexpected rank loss, missing history or failed restoration fails/blocks.
safety_gate: Dedicated isolated SUT with explicit raw-write and AC-cycle authorization.
Require independent OOB/power control and known-good signed recovery image or CMOS procedure.
Preserve all evidence before clearing PMIC status.
No automatic power cycle, flash, CMOS clear, retry or second injection.
expected_evidence: Approved clear/recovery, full-memory health and restored settings
test_case.recovery: If shutdown/boot/isolation differs, preserve evidence and stop. Use only owner-approved OOB power, status clear and signed IFWI or CMOS recovery; never retry automatically, and verify all DIMMs plus BIOS/BMC/OS health afterward.
